title: SRE ops sketch and handoff log — Apr 18 2027
content:
Context and purpose:
This is a lightweight weekly sketch summarizing the SRE cadence for the week of 2027-04-11 to 2027-04-18. Focus: incident recap, short SLO snapshot, handoff notes, runbook edits, and immediate action items. This doc is intentionally informal — use as oncall reference and meeting prep.

Attendees (async + in-standup):
- Aisha Patel (owner) — primary oncall coordinator
- Evan Morales — infra engineer, autoscaler work
- Lena Cho — monitoring / alerts
- Mateo Alvarez — serving runtime lead
- Samira Khan — incident commander during 2027-04-14 outage

Summary timeline (select events):
1) 2027-04-13 03:12 UTC — Elevated error rate for hosted text-generation route (model: redwood-v1-small-quant). 13% 5m error spike, apdex dip.
   - Triage: initial alert from prefix-cache hitrate alert (prometheus: prefix_cache_hit_below_0_65).
   - Root cause hypothesis: aggressive cache eviction after a kernel upgrade on dedicated autoscaler nodes; new kernel impacted mmap behavior under high memory churn.
   - Mitigation applied: temporarily disabled the newest kernel image rollout, scaled reserve pool to +20% capacity, and enabled fallback model variant (redwood-v1-small-fp16) for high-latency requests. Error rate returned to baseline within ~28 minutes.

2) 2027-04-14 11:05 UTC — Customer-reported tail-latency spikes on dedicated pool in us-west-2.
   - Investigation found correlated GC pauses in the host side metrics and multi-tenant scheduling backlog.
   - Short term: moved high-throughput customers to isolated dedicated nodes and tightened per-customer concurrency caps.
   - Follow-up: schedule capacity isolation work (see action items).

SLO snapshot (current window: rolling 30d):
- Text generation availability SLO: target 99.90%
  - Current: 99.82% (window shows small drift driven by 2027-04-13 incident).
- Median latency (token-gen route): target < 180ms
  - Current median: 165ms
- P99 latency: target < 1200ms
  - Current: 1,380ms (above target; primary drivers: cache misses + GC events on specific nodes)

Alerts and tuning notes:
- prefix_cache_hit_below_0_65 (fired 3x this week). Owner: Lena. Short term: increase alert recovery slack to 3 minutes to reduce noise, but keep page on sustained (>10 min) degradation.
- node_autoscale_fallback_rate (new alert) — triggered twice during the kernel rollout. Owner: Evan. Action: add pre-rollout dry-run check for mmap/hugepage behavior.

Incident postmortem plan:
- Postmortem doc draft created: CONFLUENCE-9876-postmortem-cache-eviction (Samira + Mateo). Aim for RCA + remediation list by 2027-04-22.
- Immediate remediation priorities: rollback kernel images from the rollout, add mmap regression test to release gating, add a blackbox cache-hit synthetic to surface regressions pre-deploy.

Runbook edits (quick list):
- Update: "Fallback model activation" runbook to include explicit steps to toggle rollout traffic split in the routing layer and validate KV-cache warmup. Owner: Mateo. Due: 2027-04-21.
- Add section in "Kernel rollout checklist" documenting memory-mapping smoke test. Owner: Evan. Due: 2027-04-20.
- Expand "Dedicated pool isolation" runbook with per-customer concurrency knobs and a soft-failover procedure. Owner: Aisha. Due: 2027-04-25.

On-call handoff (incoming shift notes):
- Outgoing oncall: Samira Khan — left notes on the incident state, stable after mitigations, monitoring for cache-hit regressions.
- Incoming oncall: Evan Morales — watch for any recurrence of prefix cache alerts and the new autoscale fallback alert.
- Slack bridge: #sre-ops (tag: @oncall). Pager duty escalation: primary -> secondary -> eng-lead sequence unchanged.

Action items (short-term):
- [Aisha] Draft customer-facing summary for impacted customers (aim for a short blameless explanation and next steps) — due 2027-04-20.
- [Mateo] Implement runbook edit for fallback model activation and test local KV warmup scenario — due 2027-04-21.
- [Evan] Add mmap/hugepage check to rollout CI and coordinate with infra release team to pause ongoing kernel rollouts until green — due 2027-04-20.
- [Lena] Adjust alert thresholds and recovery slack for prefix cache alert to reduce false positives; add a synthetic job that exercises cache patterns every 5 minutes — due 2027-04-22.
- [Samira] Finalize postmortem draft and list remediation tickets in JIRA-SRE-4123 — due 2027-04-22.

Medium-term items (for next 2 sprints):
- Capacity isolation: quantify customer tail-latency impact and propose a tiered deduplication/isolation scheme (owner: Mateo + infra).
- Observability: instrument KV-cache eviction reasons in detailed traces and expose to tracing UIs to make root causes searchable (owner: Lena + monitoring).
- Cost/Performance tradeoffs: run an experiment on fallback model split ratios to measure quality delta vs cost savings (owner: product/serving).

Notes for the ops retrospective meeting (2027-04-20):
- Bring example request traces showing pre/post mitigation latencies.
- Demo the new automatic fallback toggle in a staging rollout.
- Discuss whether current SLO windows (30d) mask frequent short regressions; possible switch to hybrid windowing for alerting.

Quick wins / small housekeeping:
- Remove stale runbook step referencing the old autoscaler API (PR in repo pending: github.com/redwood-inference/ops-docs/pull/56).
- Reassign stale oncall rotation overlap: add two more folks to the rotation for May to reduce fatigue (proposal in team thread).

Open questions / unresolved:
- Is the kernel regression strictly limited to the new image, or is interaction with memory pressure and specific model memory footprint required? (action: triage with infra team and run matrixed smoke tests).
- Should we convert the prefix-cache alert to a signal that triggers an automated light-weight fallback instead of only paging? (pro: faster mitigation; con: risk of masking root cause).

References and logs:
- Incident timeline (raw): https://internal-logs.redwood/incident/2027-04-13-icache-987 (view only)
- Postmortem draft: CONFLUENCE-9876-postmortem-cache-eviction
- Related PRs: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/284 (autoscaler change), github.com/redwood-inference/ops-docs/pull/56 (runbook cleanup)

If anything is missing or you want me to expand the postmortem narrative before the retro, ping me in #sre-ops or assign me on JIRA-SRE-4123.

End of sketch.
